usage: llm-modelbench watch [-h] [--run-id RUN_ID] [--out OUT]
                            [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                            [--layout {full,compact,bars,failures,hardware,repair,context,interactive}]
                            [--refresh REFRESH] [--no-clear] [--follow-queue]
                            [--no-follow-queue] [--idle-grace IDLE_GRACE]
                            [--screen {auto,alternate,normal,scroll}] [--once]
                            [--exit-when-done] [--mock]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID       which run to watch; if omitted, auto-detects from
                        --runs-dir (auto-picks if unambiguous, otherwise
                        prompts)
  --out OUT             run directory or base output directory (default: runs
                        when --run-id is used)
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   where to look for runs when --run-id/--out are omitted
  --layout {full,compact,bars,failures,hardware,repair,context,interactive}
  --refresh REFRESH
  --no-clear            append frames instead of redrawing the terminal
  --follow-queue        follow the whole queue: auto-advance to whatever run
                        starts next once the current one finishes, until
                        nothing new appears, then print a summary and exit.
                        This is the default when no --run-id/--out/--once is
                        given.
  --no-follow-queue     opt out of queue-following; watch whatever's auto-
                        picked (or --run-id/--out) once, the old single-run
                        behavior
  --idle-grace IDLE_GRACE
                        with queue-following, seconds with no new run
                        appearing before concluding the queue is finished
                        (default 180)
  --screen {auto,alternate,normal,scroll}
                        rendering mode: auto/alternate keeps a single
                        dashboard window; normal redraws current screen;
                        scroll appends
  --once                render one dashboard frame and exit
  --exit-when-done      exit when a repair campaign reaches
                        complete/partial/failed
  --mock
